zh.summary: 便携包显著减少小文件，同时完整保留官方 DSH、插件市场和插件管理能力。
highlights: Windows 完整包减少约 15% 的落地文件和约 14% 的文件系统项目，复制、解压、移动与删除时需要处理的项目更少。
插件市场的服务端和界面产物合并为紧凑的成品文件；发现、安装、更新、卸载、诊断与重启提示保持不变。
只移除 Node 运行时不会选择的重复依赖构建；Amazon Bedrock、OpenTelemetry、官方 DSH 与第三方插件流程均通过成品验收。
Windows、macOS 与 Linux 构建现在都会产出体积报告；Windows 发行门会阻止文件数、目录数、落地体积或市场体积意外反弹。

en.summary: The portable package now carries substantially fewer small files while preserving official DSH, the Plugin Market, and plugin management.
highlights: The complete Windows package contains about 15% fewer files and 14% fewer filesystem items, reducing the amount of work needed when extracting, copying, moving, or deleting it.
The Plugin Market server and client are packaged as compact production artifacts without removing discovery, install, update, uninstall, diagnostics, or restart guidance.
Only duplicate dependency builds that Node never selects are removed. Amazon Bedrock, OpenTelemetry, official DSH, and third-party plugin flows pass finished-product acceptance.
Windows, macOS, and Linux builds now emit footprint reports, while the Windows release gate blocks unexpected regressions in files, directories, extracted size, or market size.
